findings.evidence: grep for `offCurve|of_avoidance` in TauCeti/ returns `offCurve` only at the three new sites and their docstrings; `of_avoidance` appears in Basic.lean:123,129, Continuity.lean:39,88, Reverse.lean:76, Concat.lean:107, HungerbuhlerWasem.lean:127. grep for `^def ` in TauCeti/Analysis/Contour/Curve/ finds no `offCurve` definition.
findings.fix: Either rename to the established vocabulary (`windingNumber_eq_of_isPreconnected_of_avoidance`, `windingNumber_eq_zero_of_isPreconnected_of_unbounded_of_avoidance`, `isOpen_setOf_avoidance`), or, if `offCurve` is to become the library term, introduce an actual `def offCurve (γ : ℝ → ℂ) (a b : ℝ) : Set ℂ` and state these lemmas against it so the name references a real declaration.
findings.issue: `windingNumber_eq_of_subset_offCurve_of_isPreconnected` (line 65), `windingNumber_eq_zero_of_subset_offCurve_of_isPreconnected_of_unbounded` (line 92), and `isOpen_offCurve_of_continuousOn` (Curve/Distance.lean:44) coin `offCurve` for the hypothesis `∀ t ∈ uIcc a b, γ t ≠ w`, which every existing declaration in this namespace calls `avoidance` (`windingNumber_eq_integral_of_avoidance`, `continuousAt_windingNumber_of_avoidance`, `cauchyPVExistsAt_of_avoidance`, `HasCauchyPVAt.of_avoidance`, `IsNullHomologous.symm_of_avoidance`, `IsNullHomologous.concat_of_avoidance`). Two names for one concept in one namespace, and `offCurve` matches no definition, contrary to the convention that `_`-separated components correspond to a definition name or connective.

summary: Names describe their conclusions in the right shape and hypothesis order, and no notation is added, but the PR introduces a new term `offCurve` for the predicate this library already names `avoidance` everywhere, and `offCurve` corresponds to no definition.
